svg.text: Season marks and four families in two seasons
SEASONMARK1. Sixteen marks, currentColor only, drawn here at 160 px. Wireframes at 1920 x 1080 from spec.json; each red box is the mark's rectangle.
Rendered by resvg-js (bunx @resvg/resvg-js-cli, bundled faces); text widths measured with fontTools, so a kicker's end is within a few percent of the engine's.
Serif italic (d6): the mark follows the kicker word on the top line
Christmas . colourway natal (new, dark) . mark christmas . 48 px . role mute
Easter . colourway paskah (existing, light) . mark easter . 48 px . role mute
Neon night (d3): the mark sits inside the first neon ring
Christmas . colourway natal (new, dark) . mark christmas . 88 px . the ring's colour
Easter . colourway paskah (existing, dark) . mark easter . 88 px . the ring's colour
Liturgy (d11): the mark takes the place of the small cross
Christmas . colourway natal (new, dark) . mark christmas . 56 px . role gold
Easter . colourway paskah (new, light) . mark easter . 56 px . role gold
Warm (d17): the mark follows the kicker on the top line
Christmas . colourway natal (new, dark) . mark christmas . 48 px . role accent
Easter . colourway paskah (existing, light) . mark easter . 48 px . role accent
